hook.en: A bus goes 60 km to Mysuru at 40 km/h and returns at 60 km/h. Most people say the average speed is 50 km/h. It is actually 48 km/h. The right average is the harmonic mean.
hook.kn: ಬಸ್ 60 ಕಿ.ಮೀ. ಮೈಸೂರಿಗೆ ಗಂಟೆಗೆ 40 ಕಿ.ಮೀ. ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಗಿ 60 ಕಿ.ಮೀ. ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗ 50 ಅಲ್ಲ, 48 ಕಿ.ಮೀ./ಗಂ. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಹರಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಾಧ್ಯ.

narration.en: A bus goes 60 km to Mysuru at 40 km/h and returns at 60 km/h. Most people say the average speed is 50 km/h. It is actually 48 km/h. The right average is the harmonic mean.
narration.kn: ಬಸ್ 60 ಕಿ.ಮೀ. ಮೈಸೂರಿಗೆ ಗಂಟೆಗೆ 40 ಕಿ.ಮೀ. ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಗಿ 60 ಕಿ.ಮೀ. ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗ 50 ಅಲ್ಲ, 48 ಕಿ.ಮೀ./ಗಂ. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಹರಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಾಧ್ಯ.

body.en: The geometric mean of n positive values is the nth root of their product. In practice we use logarithms: $\log GM = \sum \log x / n$, so GM = antilog of the mean of the logs. GM is the right average for ratios, percentages and rates of growth (population, production, prices) and is used in index numbers. It cannot be used if any value is zero or negative.
body.kn: n ಧನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧದ n-ನೇ ಮೂಲವೇ ಗುಣೋತ್ತರ ಮಾಧ್ಯ. log GM = Σ log x / n. ಅನುಪಾತ, ಶೇಕಡಾ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ದರಗಳಿಗೆ ಇದು ಸೂಕ್ತ; ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ.

narration.en: The geometric mean of n positive values is the nth root of their product. In practice we use logarithms: log  GM = sum of  log  x / n, so GM = antilog of the mean of the logs. GM is the right average for ratios, percentages and rates of growth (population, production, prices) and is used in index numbers. It cannot be used if any value is zero or negative.

say.en: Take two numbers, 4 and 16. The arithmetic mean is 20 over 2, that is 10.
The geometric mean is the square root of 4 times 16, that is 8.
The harmonic mean is 2 over the sum of reciprocals: 6.4.
So AM is at least GM, which is at least HM. And GM squared, 64, equals AM times HM, 10 times 6.4.
Use HM for the bus: 2 over (1/40 + 1/60) is 48 km per hour.

narration.en: On the board: Three means of 4 and 16.

body.en: The harmonic mean is the reciprocal of the mean of the reciprocals: $HM = n / \sum (1/x)$. It is the right average for speeds over equal distances, and prices when equal amounts of money are spent. For positive values $AM \ge GM \ge HM$, with equality only when all values are equal. For two values, $GM^2 = AM \times HM$.
body.kn: ಹರಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಾಧ್ಯ = n / Σ(1/x). ಸಮಾನ ದೂರಗಳ ವೇಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾನ ಹಣ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಬೆಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ. AM ≥ GM ≥ HM; ಎಲ್ಲ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ಸಮವಾದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಮಾನತೆ. ಎರಡು ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ GM² = AM × HM.
